name: Numenta Anomaly Benchmark (NAB)
description: The Numenta Anomaly Benchmark (NAB) is a standardized benchmark for evaluating streaming, real-time anomaly detection algorithms on time-series data. It comprises 58 labeled time-series data files containing 365,558 data points across diverse real-world domains (AWS server metrics, Twitter traffic, web click-rates, traffic sensors, temperature telemetry) with strict anomaly window scoring.
